items.ja: 酵素玄米と野菜のプレートランチ
items.romaji: kouso genmai to yasai no pureeto ranchi
items.en: Enzyme brown-rice and vegetable plate lunch
items.note: The shop is 100% vegan by its own declaration — no animal food at all, gelatin and honey included — so vegan is solid here. Gluten is not: the shop bakes 100% wholewheat sourdough on the premises and publishes nothing about wheat-free seasoning. Price is from a 2018 listing.

items.en: Brown-rice lunch plate (leaf salad, seasonal side, soy-milk gratin, miso soup)
items.note: Reported by a visitor in 2023 at ¥1,480 + tax. The soy-milk gratin is normally flour-thickened and the miso may be barley miso — with wheat bread baked in the same kitchen, treat the whole plate as wheat-exposed.

items.ja: ヴィーガンハンバーガー（ランチプレート）
items.note: The bun is the shop's own naturally-leavened bread made with organic SPELT wheat, hand-kneaded with nut milk — spelt is wheat and contains gluten. Patties are falafel (chickpea) or takakibi millet. Vegan yes, gluten-free absolutely not.

items.ja: 有機豆と野菜のHotカレー
items.romaji: yuuki mame to yasai no hotto karee
items.en: Organic bean and vegetable hot curry
items.note: Beans and vegetables, vegan by house policy, but Japanese curry is routinely built on a wheat roux and the shop publishes no ingredient list. Ask whether the curry is thickened with flour.

items.ja: ソイミートからあげ弁当
items.note: Karaage means a flour or starch coating, and nothing here is documented as wheat-free. Reported at ¥1,320 in 2023 and ¥1,400 as a lunch.
Dandan noodles are wheat noodles, and the sesame-and-soy sauce base is wheat-soy by default. Vegan, not gluten-free.
Wheat noodles plus wheat soy sauce — two independent reasons this is out for celiac. Vegan, since the shop uses no animal stock.
Nuggets are coated and fried; no wheat-free claim exists for the coating or the oil.

items.ja: ソイミートカツサンド
items.note: Wholewheat bread plus a crumbed cutlet. Vegan, not gluten-free.

items.ja: ソイミートツナサンド
items.note: The shop's own 100% wholewheat sourdough. Vegan, not gluten-free.
Egg-free by house policy but built on the shop's wholewheat bread.
Wheat base. Vegan, not gluten-free.
Plant patties here are soy or millet; binders and sauce are undocumented and this kitchen handles wheat flour daily. Ask.

Glutinous rice and azuki are wheat-free grains and the shop's ohagi is sugar-free, so this is the most plausible wheat-free sweet here — but the same room bakes wholewheat bread and nothing is separated. Reported at ¥480 + tax and ¥510.

items.ja: 甘酒豆乳ソフトクリーム
items.note: Dairy-free by house policy. Amazake is normally rice koji, but some amazake is barley-based and the shop has published nothing — ask which. Mango sauce version ¥650 + tax.

items.ja: ガトーショコラ（乳製品不使用）
items.note: The shop bakes its own cakes with wheat flour. Dairy-free and egg-free, but not gluten-free.
Wheat cake with a drink; reported at ¥600 + tax. Strawberry tart and a vegan shortcake have also been served.

items.ja: こくもつコーヒー（インカ）
items.note: Grain coffee of this type is made from rye and barley — a gluten grain drink. Avoid it and take the real coffee instead.
Organic Colombian beans roasted in-house, black. Safe on both counts as long as nothing is added.

items.ja: 有機緑茶・ハーブティー・ジュアールティー
items.romaji: yuuki ryokucha / haabu tii / juaaru tii
items.en: Organic green tea, herbal tea, jouhar tea
items.note: Plain leaf and herb infusions; no dairy anywhere in this shop.

items.ja: 米粉パンセット（4種9個入り）
items.en: Rice-flour bread set, 4 kinds / 9 pieces (mail order)
items.note: READ THIS FIRST. The shop's own product copy says: the rice bread is made in the SAME workshop as its wheat bread, fine wheat flour can drift and mix in, and it is therefore 'not an allergy-safe product' — and its own allergen line lists WHEAT. It is a preference option, never a celiac option. The set mixes plain, chocolate (milk) and dried-shrimp rolls, so the set as a whole is not vegan.

items.ja: 米粉パン　プレーン
items.note: 100% Nara-grown rice flour with potato starch, sugar, rice oil, yeast, psyllium and salt — plant-based, and wheat-free as a recipe. But the shop itself disclaims allergy safety because wheat is baked in the same room. Ask, and do not treat it as safe for celiac.
Rice flour with black cocoa and chocolate chips; the chocolate contains milk, so not vegan. Same same-workshop wheat caveat as the plain roll.

items.ja: 米粉パン　抹茶小豆
items.en: Rice-flour roll, matcha and sweet azuki
items.note: Nara rice flour and Nara matcha wrapped around amanatto sweet beans. Plant-based; same same-workshop wheat caveat.

items.ja: 米粉パン　干しえび
items.note: Contains dried shrimp (akiami) and red 102 colouring. Not vegan; same same-workshop wheat caveat.

items.section: 食パン・食事パン / Loaves
items.note: The shop's own copy: 100% domestic wheat, additive-free, baked around 13:00 daily. Wheat — and this is the flour that makes the rice bread unsafe for celiac. Ask about milk and butter for vegan.

items.section: 食パン・食事パン / Loaves
items.note: Do not be fooled by the name — this is a wheat bread flavoured with roasted brown-rice flour, not a rice-flour bread.

items.section: 食パン・食事パン / Loaves
items.note: Wheat. Vegan status undocumented.

items.section: 食パン・食事パン / Loaves
items.note: Wheat. Usually the most plausibly dairy-free of the loaves, but confirm.

items.section: 食パン・食事パン / Loaves
items.note: Wheat. Cheapest item in the shop.

items.ja: 焙煎玄米塩バターロール
items.section: 食パン・食事パン / Loaves
items.note: Wheat dough with roasted brown-rice flour, and butter. Neither gluten-free nor vegan.
The shop's own copy says it contains wholemeal wheat flour (全粒粉入り). Crisp crust, chewy crumb.

items.ja: 天然酵母　無花果（いちじく）
items.note: Wheat sourdough. Baked around 15:00 daily.

items.ja: 天然酵母　くるみ＆ぶどう
items.note: Wheat sourdough. Baked around 15:00 daily.
Melon pan is a wheat bun under a wheat cookie crust, normally with egg and butter.
Wheat bun, wheat cookie crust.
Wheat plus dairy cream.
Wheat plus dairy ice cream. Also sold by mail order as a 10-piece box.

items.ja: キャラメルメロンパン
items.note: Wheat plus dairy caramel.
Wheat. A plain matcha version is also listed at the same price.
Wheat.
Wheat.
Wheat. A Nara-shaped novelty bun.

items.ja: みあとパン　あんバター
items.en: Miato bun, sweet bean and butter
items.note: Built on the brown-rice bread, which is still a wheat dough, plus butter.
Wheat and dairy.
Wheat.

items.ja: ふんわりフォンダンショコラ
items.note: Wheat and dairy chocolate.

items.ja: 自家炊きカスタードクリームパン
items.note: Wheat, egg and milk.

items.ja: 粒あんぱん（十勝産小豆）
items.note: Wheat bun; the azuki filling itself is plant-based.
Wheat and butter. Croissants are sold Thursdays and Saturdays only, baked around 13:00.

items.ja: クロワッサン（ショコラ）
items.note: Wheat and butter. Thursdays and Saturdays only.
Wheat and butter. Thursdays and Saturdays only; a chocolate version is ¥90.
Wheat bun, and the shop's own copy says the filling carries five grains including HATOMUGI (Job's tears) and black rice. A hot version is ¥200 as well.
Wheat dough; the pickled greens are normally soy-seasoned too.
Wheat dough, meat filling.

items.ja: みあとパン　きんぴら
items.note: Wheat bun; kinpira is soy-sauce seasoned and it is dressed with cheese and mayonnaise.
Wheat and cheese.
Wheat and pork sausage.

items.ja: みあとぱん　サバ塩焼き
items.note: Wheat bun with grilled mackerel.

items.en: Set meal of the day (the only lunch served)
items.note: There is no fixed menu at all: one cook builds a different multi-dish tray every service. Recent trays have contained pork and egg, so it is not vegetarian by default. No allergen, wheat, soy-sauce or dashi information is published anywhere — phone 0742-25-5366 ahead and discuss specifics, and reserve while you are at it.

items.ja: デザート＋ドリンクセット
items.en: Dessert and drink add-on to the set
items.note: Add-on to the ¥1,500 tray. What the dessert is changes daily — okara cake and purin have both been offered on the same day.
Documented as the dessert on a February 2026 visit. Okara cakes are normally still bound with wheat flour and egg — ask before assuming otherwise.
The alternative dessert offered on the same February 2026 visit. Egg and dairy.

items.ja: チーズを使っていないチーズケーキ
items.note: Reported in January 2024. Dairy-free by description, but the base and any egg are undocumented.

items.en: Pork and daikon simmered in miso
items.section: 御膳の一例（日替わり） / Example tray dishes
items.note: One dish from the February 2026 tray, recorded so you know the register of the cooking — it will not be there when you visit. Pork; and miso can be barley miso.

items.ja: 人参と大根の春雨スープ
items.romaji: ninjin to daikon no harusame suupu
items.en: Carrot and daikon glass-noodle soup, hot-and-sour style
items.section: 御膳の一例（日替わり） / Example tray dishes
items.note: From the February 2026 tray. Harusame is normally potato or mung starch rather than wheat, but hot-and-sour seasoning means soy sauce and vinegar — ask. Stock base unknown.

items.ja: カボチャと芽キャベツの焼きサラダ
items.romaji: kabocha to mekyabetsu no yaki sarada
items.en: Roasted pumpkin and brussels sprout salad
items.section: 御膳の一例（日替わり） / Example tray dishes
items.note: From the February 2026 tray — served with an egg-free vegan mayonnaise, which is the clearest sign this cook will accommodate if asked in advance.

items.ja: ほうれん草ともやしのナムル
items.section: 御膳の一例（日替わり） / Example tray dishes
items.note: From the February 2026 tray. Namul is sesame-and-soy seasoned; soy sauce is wheat-based by default.

items.ja: 白菜と厚揚げと蓮根のくず煮
items.romaji: hakusai to atsuage to renkon no kuzu-ni
items.en: Chinese cabbage, fried tofu and lotus root in kuzu-thickened broth
items.section: 御膳の一例（日替わり） / Example tray dishes
items.note: From the February 2026 tray. Kuzu starch is wheat-free, but 'kuzu-ko' sold in Japan is often cut with potato starch or wheat starch, and the broth is likely dashi and soy sauce.

items.ja: じゃがいもとひじきのオムレツ
items.section: 御膳の一例（日替わり） / Example tray dishes
items.note: From a July 2025 tray. Egg.

items.en: Clear soup with kinako (soy flour) noodles
items.section: 御膳の一例（日替わり） / Example tray dishes
items.note: Opening course on a July 2025 tray. Soy-flour noodles are usually still wheat-blended, and osuimono is a dashi broth.
Served with the tray. A blend of plants, herbs and Chinese medicinal ingredients — such blends sometimes include barley or hatomugi, so ask if you are celiac.

items.ja: ブルーベリージュース
items.note: Made from berries the owner picks herself; documented on a July 2025 visit.

items.ja: コーヒー・紅茶・ハーブティー
items.note: The drink choices offered with the dessert add-on. Ask about milk.

Reported at ¥1,500 tax-included. Halal-certified kitchen with no pork and no alcohol, but nothing is published about wheat: North Indian gravies are often finished with cream and sometimes thickened with flour, and it arrives with naan by default. Order it with basmati rice instead and ask about the gravy.
Oldest reported price (2018); heat level is chooseable. Wheat status undocumented.
Plain long-grain basmati — the one thing here that is wheat-free by nature. Ask for it plain and order it in place of the naan.

Biryani is rice-based, so it is the most promising dish on the board for a wheat-avoider — but no ingredient or fryer information exists for this shop, and fried-onion garnish is sometimes flour-dusted. Ask.
Reported at ¥1,500. Tandoori marinades are yoghurt-and-spice, usually wheat-free, but this is unconfirmed and the tandoor also bakes naan.
Reported in 2023, basmati coloured in patches. Wheat status undocumented.

items.ja: ビーフブハナ・キチュリ
items.note: Reported at ¥1,700 in January 2026. Bhuna is a dry Bangladeshi-style curry and khichuri is a rice-and-lentil dish — rice-based, but unconfirmed on wheat.

items.ja: ランチセット（カレー＋チーズナン＋サラダ＋マンゴーラッシー）
items.romaji: ranchi setto (karee, chiizu nan, sarada, mangoo rasshii)
items.en: Lunch set: curry, cheese naan, salad, mango lassi
items.note: Reported at ¥1,600 in 2022 and again in November 2025. The cheese naan is wheat and dairy — this set is out for celiac and for vegans; ask whether they will swap the naan for rice.
Wheat flatbread stuffed with cheese. A whole one comes with the lunch set.
Wheat flatbread, baked in the same tandoor as everything else. Not an option for celiac.

items.ja: ラムうどん（スパイシー）
items.note: Udon is wheat. Worth knowing that the kitchen told a visitor every udon dish can be made spicy and that they will 'do just about anything' on request — which is the opening for asking about substitutions, not a wheat-free claim.
Coconut-milk spicy soup with slippery harusame-style noodles, chicken, thin fried tofu and boiled egg. Glass noodles may be starch rather than wheat, but nothing is documented — ask.
Reported at ¥1,000 tax-included. Rice-based, but omurice is ketchup-and-soy seasoned as a rule. Egg and chicken.
Described as karaage-style fried wings — a flour or starch coating and a shared fryer.
Lentils are naturally wheat-free and this is the most likely plant-based dish on the board, but the shop publishes nothing — confirm no ghee and no wheat-thickened tempering.
Yoghurt drink; dairy.
